propositions: Minor release 0.12.0 requires coordinated version bumps across pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock with lockstep validation.
CHANGELOG.md pre-existing defect (duplicate [Unreleased] headers) must be consolidated into hand-curated 0.12.0 section with fresh [Unreleased] and updated compare links.
Release workflow (release.yml dispatch from main with version=0.12.0) requires pypi environment approval and must complete all 10 jobs successfully.
Published artifacts (wheel, sdist, GitHub Release, PyPI, MCP Registry, Homebrew formula) must pass verification including PEP 740 attestation and channel smoke test.
Git harness environment variable injection (GIT_CONFIG_* safe.bareRepository=explicit) causes test fixture failures unrelated to code changes and must be excluded from release validation.
